components.name: Pump Unit
components.description: Generic hydraulic pump family. Pump type, duty, materials, manufacturer and model require an equipment datasheet.

components.name: Pump Casing and Spiral Case
components.description: Pump casing or spiral-case component family. The source tag alone does not identify the measured quantity.

parameters.name: Spiral Case 1
parameters.note: Confirm whether this is pressure, temperature, drain status or another quantity.

components.name: Pump Discharge Line
components.description: Discharge-line component family with a pressure measurement point. Pressure reference and transmitter range remain unverified.

parameters.name: Discharge Pressure
parameters.note: Confirm source units and gauge versus absolute pressure; no operating limits are assumed.

components.name: Thrust Axial Pad
components.description: Axial thrust-pad component family. Pad identifiers are preserved without inferring sensor type from the suffix.

parameters.name: Thrust Axial Pad {channel}
parameters.note: D5 is preserved as supplied; confirm whether the measurement is temperature, displacement or another quantity.

components.name: Guide Radial Pad
components.description: Guide or radial-pad component family. Measurement semantics require the source tag dictionary.

parameters.name: Guide Radial Pad {channel}
parameters.note: D6 is preserved as supplied; do not assume temperature or displacement units.

components.name: Electric Motor
components.description: Electric motor family with core and winding temperature channels and speed. Rated power, voltage and insulation class are not specified.

parameters.name: Motor Core RTD {channel}
parameters.note: Temperature is inferred from the supplied description; verify Celsius versus raw RTD resistance and source scaling.

parameters.name: Motor Winding Temperature {channel}
parameters.note: Confirm Celsius and channel numbering against the source dictionary; no thermal limits are assumed.

parameters.name: Motor Shaft Speed
parameters.note: Confirm revolutions per minute versus another source scaling.

components.name: Motor Control System
components.description: Logical grouping for motor state indications, not a physical spare part or a control-system write interface.

parameters.name: Motor ON Status
parameters.note: Verify status encoding and polarity. Blank means unknown, not OFF; this is not a checkbox.

parameters.name: Motor OFF Status
parameters.note: Verify status encoding and polarity independently from the ON indication.

components.name: Motor Non-Drive-End Bearing
components.description: Non-drive-end motor bearing family. Vibration quantity, axis and RMS or peak convention require instrumentation details.

parameters.name: Motor NDE Bearing Vibration {channel}
parameters.note: May be displacement, velocity or acceleration; do not assume mm/s or an alarm threshold.

components.name: Motor Drive-End Bearing
components.description: Drive-end motor bearing family. Confirm the actual vibration sensor mounting point before assigning installed equipment.

parameters.name: Motor DE Vibration {channel}
parameters.note: Confirm displacement, velocity or acceleration, sensor axis and RMS or peak convention.

components.name: Thrust Bearing
components.description: Thrust-bearing component family with supplied temperature and vibration channels. Not an installed bearing or a stocked quantity.

parameters.name: Thrust Bearing Pad RTD {channel}
parameters.note: Verify that the source reports temperature rather than RTD resistance, and confirm its scale.

parameters.name: Pump Thrust Bearing Vibration {channel}
parameters.note: Confirm displacement, velocity or acceleration and RMS or peak convention.

components.name: Guide Radial Bearing
components.description: Guide or radial-bearing family. Supplied radial-pad tags are defined separately under Guide Radial Pad to avoid duplicate signal ownership.

components.name: Pump Cooling Water System
components.description: Cooling-water system family. Shared versus dedicated installation and hydraulic connections will be assigned later.

parameters.name: Cooling Water Inlet Temperature {channel}
parameters.note: Confirm source temperature scale and measurement locations.

parameters.name: Cooling Water Outlet Temperature {channel}
parameters.note: Confirm source temperature scale and measurement locations.

parameters.name: Inlet Cooling Water Temperature D3
parameters.note: Preserve the repeated PUMP and D3 spelling; check for an alias of another inlet channel before binding.

components.name: Motor Ventilation and Cooling System
components.description: Motor air-cooling system family with supplied cold-air and hot-air temperature channels.

parameters.name: Motor Cold Air Temperature {channel}
parameters.note: Space in the source tag is preserved; confirm whether the actual dictionary uses a space or underscore.

parameters.name: Motor Hot Air Temperature 2
parameters.note: Only channel 2 was supplied; preserve the space and confirm the real tag spelling.

components.name: HOPD Valve
components.description: Valve family identified by the supplied HOPD label. Acronym expansion, valve type, size and actuator details remain unverified.

parameters.name: HOPD Valve Position
parameters.note: Confirm 0-100 percent versus fraction, angle or travel and the open/closed polarity.

components.name: EOPD Valve
components.description: Valve family identified by the supplied EOPD label. Acronym expansion, valve type, size and actuator details remain unverified.

parameters.name: EOPD Valve Position
parameters.note: Confirm 0-100 percent versus fraction, angle or travel and the open/closed polarity.

components.name: Motor Electrical System
components.description: Logical grouping for motor electrical measurements, not a physical replacement part. Instrument scales and ratings are unverified.

parameters.name: Active Power
parameters.note: Confirm W, kW or MW and import/export sign convention.

parameters.name: Reactive Power
parameters.note: Confirm var, kvar or Mvar and sign convention. A validated reactive-power unit definition is required; do not label it kW.

parameters.name: Power Factor
parameters.note: Typo preserved. Confirm ratio versus percentage, sign and leading/lagging encoding before use.

parameters.name: Average Motor Current
parameters.note: Confirm amperes and CT scaling; this is an average as named, not an inferred phase current.

parameters.name: Line-to-Line Voltage
parameters.note: Confirm V versus kV and VT scaling; no rated voltage is supplied.

parameters.name: Operating Frequency
parameters.note: Confirm line versus drive-output frequency. This tag does not prove a VFD is installed.

components.name: Motor Excitation System
components.description: Logical grouping for motor excitation field measurements. Excitation equipment presence and construction require confirmation.

parameters.name: Excitation Field Current
parameters.note: Confirm field-current unit, scaling and DC measurement convention.

parameters.name: Excitation Field Voltage
parameters.note: Confirm field-voltage unit, scaling and DC measurement convention.

components.name: Variable Frequency Drive
components.description: Optional VFD component family. Inclusion in this catalogue does not assert a drive exists on any pump; frequency is defined under Motor Electrical System.

components.name: Forebay and Intake Structure
components.description: Forebay or intake structure family. No station identity, physical dimensions or ownership is assigned.

parameters.name: Forebay Water Level
parameters.note: Typo preserved. Confirm unit, datum and whether the value is elevation or depth.

components.name: Equipment Status Group
components.description: Logical group for the ambiguous st source field. Pump versus station ownership and state encoding will be resolved during site mapping.

parameters.name: Equipment Status
parameters.note: Preserve case; do not assign this to a pump or pumphouse until the JSON context and state encoding are known.
